page.title: 比較対象を文まで広げる

analysis.summaryJa: asやthanの後ろを名詞だけでなく節まで広げ、省略された動詞や代用表現を補いながら対応する要素同士を比較する。
grammarPoints: as/thanの後ろに主語と動詞を置ける
重複部分は助動詞やdoで代用できる
one/ones、that/those、所有代名詞で比較対象を明確にする
同じ種類・同じ範囲のもの同士を比べる
visualEvidence: 比較の境界を越えて節へ伸びる矢印が描かれる
空所の位置が省略された動詞・目的語を示す
名詞の代用語が左右の対応を保つ
所有格の矢印が誰の物かを明確にする
commonTraps: 人と物など異なる種類を直接比べない
thanの後の節で必要な助動詞を落とさない
単数oneと複数onesを混同しない
thatとthoseの数を先行名詞に合わせる

questions.prompt: The revised booking page loads as quickly as the previous version -------.
questions.translationJa: 改訂予約ページは旧版と同じ速さで読み込まれます。
questions.explanationJa: previous version loadedの重複を過去形の代用動詞didで受けます。

questions.prompt: Our warehouse shipped more orders in June than it ------- in May.
questions.translationJa: 当社倉庫は5月より6月に多くの注文を出荷しました。
questions.explanationJa: shipped ordersの反復を過去形didで代用します。

questions.prompt: The maintenance costs of the new vans are lower than ------- of the vehicles they replaced.
questions.translationJa: 新しいバンの保守費用は交換前の車両の保守費用より低いです。
questions.explanationJa: 複数名詞costsの反復をthoseで受けます。
questions.focus: thoseによる複数名詞の代用

questions.prompt: Ms. Singh's presentation was more detailed than -------.
questions.translationJa: シンさんの発表は私の発表より詳しかったです。
questions.explanationJa: my presentationを所有代名詞mineで表します。
questions.focus: 所有代名詞による比較

questions.prompt: The supplier delivered the replacement parts earlier than we -------.
questions.translationJa: 供給業者は私たちが予想したより早く交換部品を届けました。
questions.explanationJa: thanの後ろに主語weと過去動詞expectedを置いた節が必要です。

questions.prompt: The safety record of Plant A is as strong as ------- of Plant B.
questions.translationJa: A工場の安全実績はB工場の安全実績と同じくらい良好です。
questions.explanationJa: 単数名詞recordの反復をthatで受けます。
questions.focus: thatによる単数名詞の代用

questions.prompt: The new help desk resolved more cases than the internal audit predicted it -------.
questions.translationJa: 新しい窓口は内部監査が予測した以上の案件を解決しました。
questions.explanationJa: predictedに続く過去から見た未来はwouldで、would resolveが省略されています。

questions.prompt: The chairs in Conference Room B are more comfortable than the ------- in the lobby.
questions.translationJa: B会議室の椅子はロビーの椅子より快適です。
questions.explanationJa: 複数のchairsを繰り返さずonesで受けます。

questions.prompt: The mobile app is easier to navigate than the desktop site -------.
questions.translationJa: モバイルアプリはデスクトップサイトより操作しやすくなっています。
questions.explanationJa: 文脈上has beenを意識した省略としてhasを用い、現在までの状態を比べます。

questions.prompt: The customer survey produced more useful comments than we had ------- it would.
questions.translationJa: 顧客調査は私たちがそうなると思っていた以上に有用な意見を得ました。
questions.explanationJa: had thought it would produceの省略でpast perfectのthoughtが必要です。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares two monthly totals?

choices.A: We sold more units in April than March sold.
choices.B: We sold more units in April than we did in March.
choices.C: We sold more units in April as we did in March.
choices.D: We sold more units in April than did in March.

questions.translationJa: 当社は3月より4月に多くの台数を販売しました。
questions.explanationJa: than節には主語weと代用動詞didが必要です。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly avoids repeating a plural noun?

choices.A: The prices online are lower than that in the catalog.
choices.B: The prices online are lower than one in the catalog.
choices.C: The prices online are lower than ones of the catalog price.
choices.D: The prices online are lower than those in the catalog.

questions.translationJa: オンライン価格はカタログの価格より低いです。
questions.explanationJa: 複数のpricesはthoseで代用します。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares two employees' reports?

choices.A: Mr. Ito's report is clearer than mine.
choices.B: Mr. Ito's report is clearer than my.
choices.C: Mr. Ito's report is clearer than me report.
choices.D: Mr. Ito's report is clearer than I report.

questions.translationJa: 伊藤さんの報告書は私の報告書より明快です。
questions.explanationJa: my reportは所有代名詞mineに置き換えられます。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly completes the comparison clause?

choices.A: The seminar ended earlier than had we expected.
choices.B: The seminar ended earlier as we expected.
choices.C: The seminar ended earlier than we expected.
choices.D: The seminar ended earlier than expected we.

questions.translationJa: セミナーは私たちの予想より早く終わりました。
questions.explanationJa: thanの後に通常語順のwe expectedを置きます。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares singular records?

choices.A: Our retention rate is higher than those of our competitor.
choices.B: Our retention rate is higher than one our competitor.
choices.C: Our retention rate is higher than it of our competitor.
choices.D: Our retention rate is higher than that of our competitor.

questions.translationJa: 当社の継続率は競合会社の継続率より高いです。
questions.explanationJa: 単数のrateをthatで受け、that ofとします。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses an auxiliary after than?

choices.A: The new unit consumes less power than the old unit is.
choices.B: The new unit consumes less power than does the old unit consumes.
choices.C: The new unit consumes less power than the old unit does.
choices.D: The new unit consumes less power as the old unit does.

questions.translationJa: 新型機は旧型機より消費電力が少ないです。
questions.explanationJa: than節でconsumesをdoesが代用します。

questions.prompt: Which sentence compares like items correctly?

choices.A: The climate of Sendai is cooler than Fukuoka.
choices.B: The climate of Sendai is cooler than that of Fukuoka.
choices.C: The climate of Sendai is cooler than those of Fukuoka.
choices.D: The climate of Sendai is cooler than Fukuoka's city.

questions.translationJa: 仙台の気候は福岡の気候より涼しいです。
questions.explanationJa: 気候と都市を比べず、that ofで気候同士を対応させます。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses ones?

choices.A: These lockers are wider than the ones near reception.
choices.B: These lockers are wider than the one near reception are.
choices.C: These lockers are wider than that near reception.
choices.D: These lockers are wider than ones locker near reception.

questions.translationJa: これらのロッカーは受付近くのものより幅広です。
questions.explanationJa: 複数lockersをthe onesで代用します。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares expected and actual speed?

choices.A: The approval arrived sooner as we thought it would.
choices.B: The approval arrived soonest than thought.
choices.C: The approval arrived sooner than we thought it will.
choices.D: The approval arrived sooner than we thought it would.

questions.translationJa: 承認は私たちがそうなると思っていたより早く届きました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去のthoughtに対応してwould arriveを省略したwouldを用います。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares two schedules?

choices.A: Your schedule is more flexible than my.
choices.B: Your schedule is more flexible than mine.
choices.C: Your schedule is more flexible than me.
choices.D: Your schedule is more flexible as mine.

questions.translationJa: あなたの日程は私の日程より柔軟です。
questions.explanationJa: my scheduleは所有代名詞mineで受けます。

questions.prompt: The branch handled more calls than it did last Monday.

choices.A: Last Monday's call total was higher.
choices.C: The branch was closed last Monday.
choices.D: The branch handled fewer calls last Monday than it handled now.

questions.translationJa: 支店は先週月曜日より多くの電話を処理しました。
questions.explanationJa: didはhandled callsを代用し、現在側の件数が多いことを示します。

questions.prompt: Our delivery times are shorter than those of the previous carrier.

choices.A: The previous carrier always delivered sooner.
choices.B: The previous carrier's delivery times were longer than ours.
choices.D: The two carriers have identical times.

questions.translationJa: 当社の配送時間は前の運送会社のものより短いです。
questions.explanationJa: thoseはdelivery timesを受け、旧業者側の時間が長いと分かります。

questions.prompt: The final cost was lower than we had estimated it would be.

choices.A: The actual cost exceeded every estimate.
choices.C: We had expected a higher cost.
choices.D: The final cost exactly matched the estimate.

questions.translationJa: 最終費用は私たちの予想より低額でした。
questions.explanationJa: 比較節は予想額の方が実額より高かったことを示します。

questions.prompt: The warranty on this model is longer than that on Model R.

choices.A: Model R has a shorter warranty than this model.
choices.B: Both warranties cover the same period.
choices.D: That refers to Model R itself, not its warranty.

questions.translationJa: この機種の保証はR型の保証より長いです。
questions.explanationJa: thatはwarrantyを代用し、R型側の保証が短いと分かります。

questions.prompt: The new portal serves more users than the designers thought it would.

choices.A: The designers expected no users at all.
choices.B: Actual usage exceeded the designers' expectation.
choices.C: The portal serves fewer users than planned.

questions.translationJa: 新ポータルは設計者の予想より多くの利用者に使われています。
questions.explanationJa: would serve usersが省略され、実績が予測を上回った意味です。

questions.prompt: Her expense claim was more complete than mine.

choices.B: Both claims were rejected as blank.
choices.C: Mine refers to her expense claim.
choices.D: My expense claim was less complete than hers.

questions.translationJa: 彼女の経費申請は私のものより完全でした。
questions.explanationJa: mineはmy expense claimを指し、私側の完成度が低いと分かります。

questions.prompt: The batteries in the field units last as long as those in the lab units.

choices.A: The two groups of batteries have equal operating duration.
choices.C: Lab batteries always last twice as long.
choices.D: Those refers to the lab units themselves.

questions.translationJa: 現場機器の電池は実験室機器の電池と同じ時間持続します。
questions.explanationJa: thoseはbatteriesを受け、持続時間が同じだと表します。

questions.prompt: The revised brochure reads more smoothly than the first draft did.

choices.A: The first draft was never written.
choices.C: The first draft reads less smoothly than the revision.
choices.D: Did refers to printing the brochure.

questions.translationJa: 改訂冊子は初稿より滑らかに読めます。
questions.explanationJa: didはreadを代用し、初稿側が劣ることを示します。

questions.prompt: The attendance at this year's forum was higher than that at last year's forum.

choices.A: More people attended this year's forum.
choices.D: That refers to the forum building.

questions.translationJa: 今年のフォーラムの参加者数は昨年より多かったです。
questions.explanationJa: thatはattendanceを代用し、今年側が高いと表します。

questions.prompt: The device performed better than the technicians had believed it could.

choices.C: The belief matched the result exactly.
choices.D: Its actual performance exceeded their expectation.

questions.translationJa: 機器の実績は技術者が可能だと考えていた水準を上回りました。
questions.explanationJa: could performが省略され、予想以上の実績を示します。

questions.prompt: The sales team expected 300 registrations, but 460 people signed up. The campaign attracted more participants than the team thought it -------.
questions.translationJa: 登録者が予想を上回り、キャンペーンはチームが予想したより多くの参加者を集めました。
questions.explanationJa: thoughtの後ではwould attract participantsが省略されています。

questions.prompt: We compared our repair charges with the competitor's charges. Ours are lower than ------- listed on its website.
questions.translationJa: 当社の修理料金は競合サイト掲載の料金より低いです。
questions.explanationJa: 複数chargesをthoseで受けます。

questions.prompt: The test room reached the target temperature in eight minutes. This was sooner than the engineers had predicted it -------.
questions.translationJa: 試験室は技術者の予測より早く目標温度に達しました。
questions.explanationJa: would reach the target temperatureの重複部分が省略されています。

questions.prompt: The warranty for the commercial printer lasts five years. It is longer than ------- for the home model.
questions.translationJa: 業務用プリンターの保証は家庭用機種の保証より長いです。
questions.explanationJa: 単数warrantyをthatで代用します。

questions.prompt: Mr. Cole completed his inspection at 3:00, and Ms. Rana finished at 3:30. Mr. Cole worked faster than Ms. Rana -------.
questions.translationJa: コール氏はラナ氏より速く作業しました。
questions.explanationJa: workedの反復を過去形didで受けます。

questions.prompt: The northern branches use modern scanners, whereas the southern branches still use older models. The scanners in the north are more accurate than ------- in the south.
questions.translationJa: 北部支店のスキャナーは南部支店のものより正確です。
questions.explanationJa: 複数scannersをthoseで代用します。

questions.prompt: My estimate included installation, but Elena's did not. Therefore, her total is lower than -------.
questions.translationJa: 私の見積もりには設置費が含まれ、エレナの合計は私のものより低いです。
questions.explanationJa: my totalを所有代名詞mineで受けます。

questions.prompt: The trial store served 900 customers; the established store served 1,100. The trial store did not serve as many customers as the established store -------.
questions.translationJa: 試験店舗は既存店舗ほど多くの顧客に対応しませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: served customersをdidで代用します。

questions.prompt: The old website required nine steps to submit a request. The new one requires five, making it easier to use than the old site -------.
questions.translationJa: 新サイトは旧サイトより使いやすくなっています。
questions.explanationJa: old site is easy to useの補語部分を省略し、be動詞isを残します。

questions.prompt: The consultant predicted a modest improvement, but complaints fell by 40 percent. The new procedure was more effective than she had believed it -------.
questions.translationJa: 苦情が大きく減り、新手順はコンサルタントが考えていたより効果的でした。
questions.explanationJa: believed it would be effectiveのeffectiveを省略したwould beが必要です。
